test_roi_align_forward_output: test the ROIAlign forward pass with and without alignment correction on a 5x5 input grid
test_roi_align_resize_consistency: test that ROIAlign produces consistent results when the input image and box are resized together
test_roi_align_grid_sample_equivalence: test that ROIAlign output matches grid_sample-based ROIAlign across multiple sampling ratios
test_roi_align_empty_box: test that ROIAlign returns zero-filled output and zero gradients for degenerate empty bounding boxes
benchmark_roi_align_performance: benchmark the ROIAlign layer performance on CPU and CUDA with various box sizes and sampling ratios
